FAIL_TO_PASS: break-statement-labels-in-loops: handles breaking to loops inside labeled statements
break-statement-loops: breaks control flow when a break statement is encountered inside a loop
loop-errors: does not break flow from inside loops that may not have executed
labeled-break-statements: keep break statements if their label is included
labeled-continue-statements: keep continue statements if their label is included
optional-chaining-with-smallest-treeshake: preserve optional chaining with smallest treeshake
recursive-assignments: do not fail for pathological recursive algorithms and circular structures
